components.explanation: The 'night is slipping' glow: night_skip.gdshader (canvas_item, typed by Shriram; colour line at line 8) on the status bar's own node (status_bar.gd, split out of hud.gd so only the bar glows), driven every frame by night_skip_driver.gd from LoopState.fast_forward during Phase.NIGHT with move_toward by delta (0.25 s in, 0.5 s out), checked by test_night_skip.gd at 30/60/144 fps through real key input, including the uniform-list assertion that catches a parse failure or a rename.

The marble deck: deck_marble.gdshader (spatial; albedo sampled as colour with source_color, roughness and an OpenGL normal map as data; world-XZ UVs; five ranged uniforms in two groups), two ShaderMaterials (marble_dry.tres with the defaults on three floors; marble_wet.tres, roughness 0.3 / specular 0.8, on FloorBack), wired in slice.tscn; Poly Haven Marble 01 textures with explicit import settings; the normal-map curl check calibrated on Floor Tiles 06; the material audit and its test.

The hint experiment: write_hint_strip.gd writes a 3x1 PNG (greys 64, 128, 192) imported lossless without mipmaps; hint_experiment.gdshader binds it to a source_color sampler and a plain one; two materials pick one each on two quads in hint_experiment.tscn (Linear tonemap, exposure 1.0).

Step 4: a StandardMaterial3D with albedo, roughness and normal map, converted in the editor to standard_generated.gdshader (unused by the game) on the sphere in scratch_standard.tscn; compared line by line with deck_marble.gdshader.
tools/capture_a5.gd: scripted real-renderer captures (glow at fixed values, hint quads, marble at a held 10 PM, the uniform sweep) that print measured pixels next to the predictions.

## The state the glow shows: the player is skipping the night (the HUD's own ">> x8" condition).
static func state_holds() -> bool:
	return LoopState.fast_forward and LoopState.phase == LoopState.Phase.NIGHT

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var target := 1.0 if state_holds() else 0.0
	var duration := FADE_IN if target > skip_amount else FADE_OUT
	skip_amount = move_toward(skip_amount, target, delta / duration)
	_apply()

[resource]
shader = ExtResource("1_marble")
shader_parameter/albedo_tex = ExtResource("2_diff")
shader_parameter/roughness_tex = ExtResource("3_rough")
shader_parameter/normal_tex = ExtResource("4_nor")
shader_parameter/roughness_scale = 0.3
shader_parameter/specular_amount = 0.8

Captured hint quads: 64/128/192 with source_color, 137/188/225 without, equal to the predictions in CHANGE-BRIEF.md 2.5.
The marble under the slice lights at a held 10 PM, and each float uniform swept to both ends of its hint_range.
Shriram's editor screenshots: a shader edit darkens all four floors; a wet-material tint changes only FloorBack.
The generated shader rendering the scratch sphere with the three marble textures (camera and light added by the capture script).
Recorded logs: deleting a semicolon fails 4 checks (empty uniform list), renaming skip_amount fails 2 while the rule checks pass, removing source_color fails the material test.
